Orangutan Rescued in Odisha Falls Ill at Zoo

A baby orangutan, previously rescued, has fallen ill at the Nandankanan Zoological Park in Odisha. Zoo officials have been placed on alert following the animal's deteriorating health. The Odisha Special Task Force (STF) is reportedly seeking assistance from police in Assam, Mizoram, and Maharashtra in connection with the orangutan case. The specific cause of the illness and the details of the ongoing orangutan case remain unspecified in the coverage.
